newFeatures.title: Update without leaving Spyhop
newFeatures.detail: Choose Check for Updates… in the Spyhop menu to find and install the latest version. Spyhop restarts automatically when the update is ready.

newFeatures.title: Release notes after each update
newFeatures.detail: See every new feature and fix in the version you just installed. Open Release Notes in the Spyhop menu whenever you need them.

fixes.title: Consistent Full reply scrollbars
fixes.detail: Expanded replies, code blocks, and tables now use the same scrollbar style as the rest of the board.
